svg.title: The reading envelope: every emitted reading carries its witnesses, retained evidence, and four postures — a support ledger in the sense of Observer Geometry III
svg.text: The reading envelope — an answer that carries its own accountability
ReadingEnvelope — attached to every observation artifact
observer_plan · observer_instance · observer_basis
who read, with what memory, in which native vocabulary
witness_refs: [ReadingWitnessRef]
ResolvedCommit(provenance ref) — or EmptyFrontier with its
deterministic state_root + commit_hash: even nothing has a witness
retained_evidence: [RetainedEvidencePosture]
refs to retained material — or an explicit missing-retention posture
parent_basis_posture — where this reading stands
Worldline · StrandHistorical · StrandAtAnchor ·
StrandParentAdvancedDisjoint · StrandRevalidationRequired(+slots)
budget_posture — requested AND spent
max_payload_bytes vs payload_bytes · max_witness_refs vs witness_refs
rights_posture — what enforcement actually ran
emission type has exactly one variant: KernelPublic
residual_posture — Complete·Residual·PluralityPreserved·Obstructed
the optic outcome algebra, recurring on the read side
OG-III reading: witness_refs ≈ carried support · missing-retention ≈ declared loss · obstruction ≈ blocked
QueryReadingIdentity — the question has a name
reading_id = H( query_id ‖ vars_digest ‖
basis_digest ‖ aperture_digest ‖
plan ‖ contract evidence )
aperture_digest = H( budget ‖ rights )
a reading's identity includes its aperture: the same
query at the same basis under a different budget or
rights posture is a different reading — observer-
relativity, priced into the hash
Type-level report honesty
request side: ObservationRights =
KernelPublic | CapabilityScoped { capability }
emission side: ReadingRightsPosture = KernelPublic
you may request a capability-scoped read, but the
envelope cannot claim capability enforcement — the
variant does not exist until the checker does.
Report ≤ Just, enforced by the type system.
A reading may claim exactly what its envelope can witness — no more.
Retained readings cross into durability as ReadingEnvelopeRetained WAL records — see the WAL/WSC deep dive.
